basic_details.short_information: Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (GSSSB), Gandhinagar, has invited applications for 227 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. 472/202627. The posts include Laboratory Technician, Class-3 (Additional Director, Public Health, Gandhinagar), Laboratory Technician, Class-3 (Additional Director, Medical Services, Gandhinagar), Laboratory Technician, Class-3 (Director, Employees' State Insurance Scheme, Ahmedabad). The online application is open from 1 December 2026 to 15 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Register on https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in with One Time Registration (OTR); only OTR-registered candidates can fill the form.
Go to Online Application, click Apply, select GSSSB and click the post name under Advt. 472/202627.
Click Apply now, enter Registration No. and date of birth and click Apply with OTR.
Fill SSC details, bank account details (with first page of passbook uploaded as JPEG, JPG or PNG) and Educational Details.
Accept the Declaration, save, and note the Application Number.
Upload photograph and signature (JPG, up to 15 kb) using Application Number and date of birth.
Confirm the application to get the Confirmation Number; no change is possible after confirmation.
Pay the fee online by 18-12-2026 (23:59 hrs) and print the application form and fee receipt.
important_instructions: Fee is refunded only to candidates who appear in the examination; not refunded if the application is cancelled Fee paid with more than one application is not refunded Scribe or compensatory time requests from eligible disabled candidates must be emailed at least two days before the exam Keep mobile number and email active; SMS may be sent Fee payment link closes automatically after 18-12-2026 and no late fee is accepted

content_sections.heading: How Will GSSSB Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Single-stage competitive MCQ examination (CBRT/OMR) with Part-A and Part-B in one paper Provisional result and merit list on total marks, with separate qualifying standard in Part-A and Part-B About twice the category-wise posts called for original certificate verification Selection list and waiting list on merit, category-wise, with candidates' order of preference of offices Examination is one paper in two parts: Part-A (general subjects, 90 marks) and Part-B (subject-related, 120 marks) Wrong answer carries negative marking of one-fourth of the marks for the question Provisional answer key is published after the exam and objections are considered before the final answer key If a question is cancelled in the final answer key, marks are calculated pro-rata on the remaining questions Five percent marks are added for widow women candidates and for recognised sportspersons

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GSSSB Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Register on https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in with One Time Registration (OTR); only OTR-registered candidates can fill the form. Go to Online Application, click Apply, select GSSSB and click the post name under Advt. 472/202627. Click Apply now, enter Registration No. and date of birth and click Apply with OTR. Fill SSC details, bank account details (with first page of passbook uploaded as JPEG, JPG or PNG) and Educational Details. Accept the Declaration, save, and note the Application Number. Upload photograph and signature (JPG, up to 15 kb) using Application Number and date of birth. Confirm the application to get the Confirmation Number; no change is possible after confirmation. Pay the fee online by 18-12-2026 (23:59 hrs) and print the application form and fee receipt. Apply on or before 15 December 2026.
